about.title:
Strategic partners for
healthcare companies going global.
about.paragraph1: Sidera Health was founded to bridge the gap between ambitious healthcare and medical device companies and the complex realities of entering new markets. We don't just advise — we connect, build, and manage the commercial infrastructure your expansion requires.
about.quote: "Entering a regulated healthcare market is not just a sales challenge — it is an organizational, clinical, and regulatory one."

service1.title: Regulatory Advisory
service1.desc: We connect you with specialized regulatory partners to obtain the certifications your medical device needs — CE Mark, ANVISA, ANMAT and more.

service2.title: Market Entry Strategy
service2.desc: We design your go-to-market strategy — pricing, positioning, channel selection and competitive analysis — grounded in real market intelligence.

service3.title: Distributor Profiling
service3.desc: We identify and evaluate distribution partners with the right healthcare expertise, market coverage, and values for your product.

service4.title: Distributor Onboarding
service4.desc: We structure agreements, train your distributors on product and compliance, and align goals and reporting from the start.

service5.title: Network Management
service5.desc: We provide ongoing management of your distribution network — monitoring performance, resolving challenges, and optimizing results.

feature.title: Built for the complexity of healthcare markets.
feature.desc: Medical devices and healthcare products face unique barriers to international expansion. Regulatory requirements, clinical evidence standards, hospital procurement cycles and distributor qualification are just some of the hurdles we help you clear.
feature.item1: CE Mark, ANVISA, ANMAT regulatory pathways

latam.title: LATAM
latam.desc: Deep coverage in Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Chile, Colombia and beyond — with full regulatory and commercial expertise.

europe.title: Europe
europe.desc: CE marking, MDR compliance and robust distributor networks are the keys to sustainable healthcare growth across the EU.

article1.title: EU MDR Transition Deadlines: What Medical Device Manufacturers Must Know Before 2026
article1.desc: The EU Medical Device Regulation continues to reshape market access timelines across Europe. We break down the key deadlines and what manufacturers should do now.

article2.title: ANVISA's New Digital Submission Platform
article2.desc: Brazil's ANVISA has rolled out an updated digital registration process for faster market access.
